name: Mordekaiser
title: the Iron Revenant

Q.name: Obliterate
Q.description: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with Nightfall dealing 80/115/150/185/220 + None+ (by level) + 1.2×bonus AD + 0.7×AP magic damage, increased to (80/115/150/185/220 + None+ (by level) + 1.2×bonus AD + 0.7×AP) × 1.3/1.35/1.4/1.45/1.5 if it hits only a single enemy.
Q.summary: Mordekaiser smashes the ground with his mace dealing damage to each enemy struck. Damage is increased when hitting a single enemy.

W.name: Indestructible
W.description: Passive: Mordekaiser stores 45% of the damage he deals and 7.5% of the damage he takes. Active: Mordekaiser gains the stored damage as Shield. He may Recast this Ability to restore 35/37.5/40/42.5/45% of the remaining Shield as Health. Minimum Shield: 0.05×max HP Maximum Shield: 0.3×max HP
W.summary: Mordekaiser stores damage he deals and takes to create a shield. He may consume the shield to heal.

E.name: Death's Grasp
E.description: Passive: Mordekaiser gains 5/7.5/10/12.5/15% Magic Penetration. Active: Pulls enemies in his direction, dealing 60/80/100/120/140 + 0.45×AP magic damage.
E.summary: Mordekaiser pulls all enemies in an area.

R.name: Realm of Death
R.description: Mordekaiser banishes a champion to the Death Realm with him for 7s, stealing 10% of their core stats for the duration. If Mordekaiser kills that enemy in the Death Realm he consumes their soul, keeping the stats he stole until the target respawns.
R.summary: Mordekaiser drags his victim to a different dimension with him and steals a portion of their stats. If he kills them, he keeps the stats until the victim respawns.

Passive.name: Darkness Rise
Passive.description: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.
Passive.summary: Mordekaiser gains a powerful damage aura and Move Speed after landing 3 attacks or spells against champions or monsters.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Juggernaut who banishes a target to the Death Realm with R and steals their stats. Wins lane with Q isolated damage and passive aura, and pulls targets into his range with E.
strengths: Q deals 30–50% more damage if it hits a single enemy
E pulls enemies toward him to set up Q
W stores damage dealt/taken as a shield; recast to heal
R banishes a champion to the Death Realm for 7 s and steals 10% of their stats
Passive aura after 3 hits deals damage and gives move speed
weaknesses: No dash: kited by ranged champions
Weak against champions who escape or out-range him
Death Realm removes allies from the fight too
profile.curveNote: Wants E pull into Q and W to trade; passive needs 3 hits.

Q.notes: Smash; bonus damage on isolated targets.

W.notes: Stored damage shield; recast to heal.

profile.windowAgainst: E on cooldown (18–10 s): he can't pull you in.
